anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Nothing moved: both outputs settle AC2/AC3/AC5 on a single Deferred/deviates line that spawns no decision item and no re-audit, both render exactly one numbered brief for the row 4 gap with 'Conformance: 1 decision needed', and both keep recommended: none while naming the missing prerequisite (closureReview.maxFixRounds is 0, fix-now unavailable) and carrying G1 open with no fix round. Note that the Expected list predicts in-scope-gap/f3 and f4 as fails->holds, but Before already satisfies both on its text, so the change is preserving rather than repairing them. Two After-only wording choices are worth tightening without touching any fact: the rationale's closing 'or an explicit human choice of accept or rescope' blurs the boundary that letters A/B select named dispositions while only free text records custom - drop that clause or say 'otherwise pick A or B by letter'; and 'round history: none - loop not entered' is weaker than Before's explicit 'carried OPEN; no fix round', so consider 'R0 PARTIAL - carried OPEN; loop not entered (maxFixRounds: 0)' to keep the carried-open status legible on the card itself. The 'whole-diff minors: not recorded' change is defensible since the reviewer report has no such line, but keep it consistent between the card and the menu footer as it is now.
